svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three rows of 610 mm flashing, each 3,850 mm long (3,800 mm round

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plus a 50 mm lap), wrapped round the side insulation.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom row on the floor; the second laps 25 mm outside it; the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: row is cut to width so the side ends 1,302 mm above the floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pull each row tight with ratchet straps over the insulation, then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rivet the vertical lap every 100 mm with 4.8 mm aluminium rivets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rivet the row laps every 150 mm. Stagger the vertical laps.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside diameter 1,208 mm: the insulation is 317 mm thick all round.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the cap's 25 mm skirt sits outside the top row and is held by

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sheet metal screws (not rivets) so the cap can come off.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The jacket runs at about 26 degrees C, so galvanized steel is fine.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: round within 10 mm on two diameters; no gaps at the laps.
